==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=ImageHash&min=ImageHash&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using CoenM.ImageHash.HashAlgorithms;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Verify.ImageHash: png, jpg and bmp snapshots are compared by perceptual hash rather than
        // byte for byte, so anti-aliasing and font hinting differences no longer fail a test.
        // Initialize() registers the comparers with the default threshold of 95 and is what marks
        // the plugin initialized, so it has to run first: RegisterComparers() does not set that
        // flag, and the trailing InitializePlugins() would call Initialize() again and win.
        VerifyImageHash.Initialize();
        // Re-registers the same three comparers with the values chosen in the wizard. The threshold
        // is a similarity percentage, so a higher number is stricter.
        VerifyImageHash.RegisterComparers(threshold: 95, algorithm: new DifferenceHash());

        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Extensions/ImageHashTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=ImageHash&min=ImageHash&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using CoenM.ImageHash.HashAlgorithms;
using SixLabors.ImageSharp;
using SixLabors.ImageSharp.PixelFormats;

// Verify.ImageHash: Compares png, jpg and bmp snapshots by perceptual hash, so a small rendering difference still passes.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.ImageHash
// Note: The threshold is a similarity percentage, so higher is stricter.
// Verify.ImageSharp.Compare's threshold is an absolute error, where lower is stricter.
// Note: A comparer only changes how an existing image snapshot is compared; nothing is rendered or
// converted.
// Note: On a mismatch the failure message prints the measured similarity, which is the number to
// register.
// Note: The package targets net8.0 only, and the assembly is not strong named.
public class ImageHashTests
{
    // Nothing in the test names the comparer: it is registered for the png extension, so every
    // png snapshot in the project is compared this way.
    [Fact]
    public Task CompareImage()
    {
        var stream = NewImage();
        return Verify(stream, "png");
    }

    // Builds a small png in memory, so the samples need no image file checked in. Replace this
    // with VerifyFile("sample.png"), or with whatever produces the image under test.
    static Stream NewImage()
    {
        using var image = new Image<Rgba32>(11, 11)
        {
            [5, 5] = Color.ParseHex("#0000FF").ToPixel<Rgba32>()
        };
        var stream = new MemoryStream();
        image.SaveAsPng(stream);
        stream.Position = 0;
        return stream;
    }
}
